root_cause.classification: CODE_DEFECT_IN_RPC_POOL (not RPC transport error, not chain outage, not economic failure)
root_cause.mechanism: _fails[url] only resets on success (_reset :283). A persistently failing endpoint accumulates fails monotonically inside a long-lived daemon (PID 2077656 ran 28 days). At fails >= 1025, 2**1024 exceeds float max and float*int raises OverflowError. In RpcPool.call (:343-372) the second _penalize inside the except-branch (:371) is outside any try, so the OverflowError escapes call() to the caller.
propagation: scripts/lp_pool_resolve_and_rank_v1_readonly.py:346 _resolve_pool_at_factory (eth_call getPool) and :378 _validate_aerodrome_candidate (eth_getCode/eth_call) catch Exception and append to probe_errors (:467-472, :495-500)
root_cause.why_only_aerodrome: uniswap-v3 uses single-factory resolve_pool_address (:536) whose exceptions fall to status=ERROR instead of this reason
